fields.Name: T292 - Integrations Visual Field Mapping Editor
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke SVG connect-the-fields visual editor (app-visual-field-editor) with connection-path rendering and field filtering — a unique code path unlike any generic form or grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click a connection card body to open its detail view, then click one of the entity-map rows in the maps table to open the visual field-mapping editor. Verify a two-column field-mapping canvas renders: a 'Source Fields' column on the left, an 'MJ Entity Fields' column on the right, SVG connection lines/badges between them, header stats (mapped / key / required counts), and per-column 'Filter fields' search inputs. Type in one of the field filter boxes and confirm the field list narrows. Seeing the SVG mapping canvas render is success — you do NOT need to create or save a mapping. If the connection has no entity maps or none exist, a clear empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking an entity-map row opens a field-mapping editor with Source Fields and MJ Entity Fields columns
Header stats (mapped / key / required) and SVG connection lines/badges are visible between the columns
A per-column field filter input narrows its field list when typed into
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
